answer: Deposits are visible in vine, and karst reconciles the forfeits at each close. A bond of 27% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Because the custody account is separate, someone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 48 aliases, and each one needs its own funded anchor account. A farm of 2183 identities would post 1430 proofs and burn roughly 4 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
